title: Among users who have earned a 'Teacher' badge and are located in Vienna, Au
question: Among users who have earned a 'Teacher' badge and are located in Vienna, Austria, find the text of the highest-scoring comment on any post they own that has between 100 and 150 views.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c."XCL_008"
FROM comments AS c
INNER JOIN posts AS p ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026"
INNER JOIN users AS u ON p."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
INNER JOIN badges AS b ON u."XCL_052" = b."XCL_002"
WHERE b."XCL_003" = 'Teacher'
  AND u."XCL_058" = 'Vienna, Austria'
  AND p."XCL_030" BETWEEN 100 AND 150
ORDER BY c."XCL_007" DESC
LIMIT 1
